hint.text: Hearing schedules for a court, by date and courtroom.

description:
Hearing schedules for a court, by date and courtroom.

Each hearing has its case number, hearing type, courtroom and start time. Schedules change during the day, so call it again rather than keeping a copy for long.

hint.text: Reference data for courthouses, rooms and sitting days.

description:
Reference data for courthouses, rooms and sitting days.

Use it to turn the codes other APIs return into names and addresses. It holds no personal data.

hint.text: Personal and case details for a named defendant.

description:
Personal and case details for a named defendant.

This API returns personal data, so production access needs a clear reason and is reviewed carefully.

hint.text: Results recorded against a hearing once it has concluded.

description:
Results recorded against a hearing once it has concluded.

Results include outcomes, orders and next hearing dates.

hint.text: Case details for a prosecution, including defendants and offences.

description:
Case details for a prosecution, including defendants and offences.

One call returns the case, its defendants and the offences charged.
